First, acknowledge that feeling overwhelmed is normal with important decisions. Since seeking reassurance is your go-to stress response, actively look for reliable information and perspectives related to your decision. Talk to trusted friends, mentors, or experts – but set boundaries to avoid getting stuck in a loop of constant reassurance.

To manage the feeling of being pulled in too many directions, let's leverage your preference for to-do lists. Break down the decision-making process into smaller, manageable steps. For example: 1) Research Option A, 2) Research Option B, 3) List Pros & Cons of Option A, 4) List Pros & Cons of Option B, 5) Discuss with [trusted person], etc. Checking off each item on the list will provide a sense of progress and control, directly addressing your stress and helping you think more clearly.
